description: List medical providers named in expert disclosures, by type, specialty, side (treating or defense examiner), town and size, most cases first. get_provider gives one provider in full.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Results per page, at most 50 (the default).

name.description: Part of the name, any case.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

side.description: treating: named as the plaintiff's treating provider; defense_examiner: retained by the defense to examine the plaintiff.

specialty.description: Part of the specialty, e.g. orthop.

name: search_providers

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

cases.description: Cases whose expert disclosures name the provider.

casesByYear.description: Cases counted by the year they were filed.

credential.description: The credential named in the filings. When the filings name none, or one outside the usual list, and the federal NPI registry finds the clinician exactly once, the credential the registry lists, e.g. "M.D.". "other" when the filings name a credential outside the usual list and the registry does not supply one. null when neither says.

kind.description: clinician: a person; practice: a clinic, hospital or other organisation.

side.description: treating: named as the plaintiff's treating provider; defense_examiner: retained by the defense to examine the plaintiff.

specialty.description: The specialty named in the filings. When the filings name none and the federal NPI registry finds the clinician exactly once and, when the filings name a credential from the usual list, lists that same credential: the registry's primary taxonomy, e.g. Orthopaedic Surgery. null otherwise.

town.description: Town the provider practises in, when known.

title: Search medical providers
